items.title: Dome installed at Pakistan's Chashma unit 5
items.summary: The inner safety dome has been installed on the containment building of unit 5 at the Chashma nuclear power plant site in Pakistan.

items.title: OPG set to revise timeline and cost of first SMR unit
items.summary: The first of four BWRX-300 small modular reactors under construction at the Darlington New Nuclear Project will not be completed within the previously planned timeline or cost, Ontario Power Generation has said.

items.title: Russia proposes carbon credits framework for SMRs
items.summary: An international methodology to allow small modular reactors to qualify for carbon credits under the terms of the Paris Agreement has been proposed to the UN's climate/COP secretariat by Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom.
